mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, real_name, email, phone, avatar_url, status, last_login_time, last_login_ip, created_at, updated_at FROM admin_users WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT id, username, password, real_name, email, phone, avatar_url, status, last_login_time, last_login_ip, created_at, updated_at FROM admin_users WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_users SET last_login_time = #{lastLoginTime}, last_login_ip = #{lastLoginIp}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_users (username, password, real_name, email, phone, avatar_url, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{avatarUrl}, #{status})
